---
title: Wav Processing
---

This page documents the preprocessing module that prepares raw recordings for downstream feature extraction and classification.

## Module overview

The wav processing module contains three main components:

- `raven_to_wav`: extracts annotated segments from source recordings using tabular annotation exports.
- `condensation`: reduces long recordings to shorter candidate-event streams to speed up manual annotation.
- `synthetic_data`: combines vocalization clips with background recordings to generate augmented training data.

- Condensation details: [condensation](condensation.qmd)
